tasks.short: Develop actual tree measurement and identification techniques

steps.what: Locate and read actual tree measurement and identification methods and relevant source evidence for the development problem
inputs: Actual technique development question
Existing forestry reference and inventory system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual selected methods and understood source evidence and limitations

steps.what: Develop techniques for measuring and identifying trees by designing the actual method and its comparison against known reference observations
inputs: Actual development need and source methods from s1
outputs: Human-designed actual technique and explicit evaluation criteria

steps.what: Try the actual tree measurement and identification method on real specimens and capture observations and comparison results
inputs: Actual trees or specimens, existing measuring tools and method from s2
Actual reference observations
outputs: Actual captured method trial observations, discrepancies and limitations

steps.what: Evaluate and write the actual technique findings and method description, reusing exact specimen identifiers and checking the complete meaning against trial evidence
inputs: Actual design and trial observations from s2-s3
Exact source and specimen identifiers captured during the work
outputs: Actual complete method development record with human evaluation and ordinary source checks

steps.what: Save the actual completed technique development record in the same document system
inputs: Actual completed record from s4
outputs: Saved actual method development record

tasks.design: Use native {OTHER} source views and exact specimen fields in the actual {DOCS} method record. Retain technique design, physical trials, evaluation and substantive method writing; the ordinary same-system save is ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source navigation and repeated specimen fields can interrupt actual method development.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference views and exact document fields can reuse selected source and trial identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: A technique must work on actual trees and be compared with real reference observations.
tasks.human_edge: Design a meaningful trial and recognise a method that fails under field conditions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source views and exact specimen fields can support method records without developing or validating a tree measurement technique by themselves.

assumptions: This illustrative non-destructive measurement and identification trial includes its actual method record. Shares are unmeasured and independent of the prompt prior; no new hazardous physical operation or automatic species classifier is introduced.

The forester reads actual sources, designs the technique and produces and captures actual specimen observations in s1-s3. No clean trial dataset, validated new technique or free source evaluation is assumed.

Native features are tried first; existing source navigation and fixed fields are baseline. Only exact field reuse reduces s4, with all actual evaluation, substantive writing and ordinary accuracy checks retained.

The author does not approve their own work or gain new decision rights. Same-system save has no gate and no saving; 1 is the schema's minimum positive share for a negligible retained action. No approved operating method, publication or hidden send is issued.
unknowns: Actual technique development workflow and repeated identifiers
research_questions: Which actual source and record-entry effort occurs in an observed technique trial?

already_counted.description: Remaining source reading, actual design and trials and substantive method evaluation and writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source views and exact specimen-field mappings.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=95.1; gross saving=4.9 from actual source navigation and fixed fields. Deduct 1.5 incremental hours once for net 3.4. Technique work and ungated same-system save remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Map actual forest soils and vegetation and estimate timber, growth and value

steps.what: Survey and verify actual forest soils, vegetation and inventory evidence and capture selected plot records, spatial references and explicit estimation rules
inputs: Actual forest and existing field inventory records
Existing forestry GIS and inventory analysis system, defined as OTHER
Actual established timber, growth and value methods and current selected price evidence
outputs: Actual verified and captured plot and soil or vegetation data, explicit spatial mappings and selected estimate formulas and assumptions

steps.what: Import exact selected plot, soil and vegetation records and construct the native GIS map from the forester's explicit spatial rules
inputs: Actual captured source data and explicit mappings and map rules from s1
outputs: Draft source-linked forest map with missing and unmatched plots exposed

steps.what: Calculate exact selected standing timber, growth and value scenarios using actual mapped inventory and the established formulas chosen by the forester
inputs: Actual selected mapped records from s2
Explicit formulas, price sources and scenario assumptions captured in s1
outputs: Draft reproducible timber, growth and value estimates with source and scenario assumptions

steps.what: Evaluate the actual map and estimates for field representativeness, model suitability, uncertainty and plausible future timber growth and value
inputs: Actual original forest evidence and mapped calculation outputs from s2-s3
outputs: Human estimate interpretation and identified limitations or necessary corrections

steps.what: Write the actual map and estimate explanation and check the entire completed artefact against field evidence, units, references, assumptions and uncertainty
inputs: Actual interpretation from s4, complete map and estimates and original evidence
outputs: Complete actual forest map and estimate record with human explanation and ordinary source checks

steps.what: Save the actual completed map and estimate record in the same system
inputs: Actual completed artefact from s5
outputs: Saved actual forest map and estimate record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} GIS imports and explicit timber, growth and value calculations from actual records selected by the forester. Keep actual field evidence production, estimation choices, interpretation and complete map and explanation checking human, with an ungated same-system save.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual manually assembled forest estimate can repeat spatial transfer and fixed scenario arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forestry GIS and formula views can reproduce explicit selected map and estimate operations.
tasks.still_hard: Future growth and value depend on model suitability and uncertain field and market conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the actual inventory and assumptions support the estimate.

ambition.what: Re-run selected estimate scenarios after verified inventory corrections.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: forestry GIS and explicit inventory formulas can calculate selected mapped estimates while field representativeness and future-value interpretation remain professional judgement.

assumptions: This conditional mapping and estimation episode has actual manual transfer and calculations. Shares are illustrative, not measured or based on the supplied prior.

The forester performs actual field verification and captures selected records, mappings, methods, units, prices and assumptions in s1. Original existing surveys remain baseline labour, not free new inputs. Missing observations require real retained collection or leave an explicit gap.

Use native forestry tools first. Existing map imports, growth models, calculations and unattended runtime are baseline and earn no new gain. No model infers species, growth, soil category or missing inventory.

All estimate interpretation and actual explanation writing and ordinary complete-source checks remain in s4-s5. No new self-approval is added. Same-system save is ungated, negligible and earns no saving; 1 is the minimum schema allocation.
No timber sale, harvest decision, controller upload or hidden publication occurs. Actual external issue or physical work needs its own real authority and separate action.
unknowns: Actual native analysis coverage and inventory quality
research_questions: Can an observed estimate be reproduced from its actual field records and explicit model and price assumptions?

already_counted.description: Actual field and source capture, estimate judgement and full explanation and map checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain spatial mappings and verified estimate formulas and test unit and source-version exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60; gross saving=40 from actual manual spatial transfer and calculations. Deduct 4 incremental hours once for net 36. Field judgement and ungated same-system save remain retained; existing model runtime earns no new gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and supervise actual forestry projects and tree establishment

steps.what: Inspect actual site and project needs and consult the land manager and crew about planting conditions, resources and constraints
inputs: Actual project site, owner objectives and crew information
Existing forestry project and GIS system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual verified site and resource evidence with captured project constraints

steps.what: Choose and capture the actual tree types, numbers, placement and supervision criteria for the planting project
inputs: Actual site and project evidence from s1
outputs: Human-selected actual planting design, quantities, locations and monitoring criteria

steps.what: Fill exact selected tree quantities and locations into the native planting map and project fields
inputs: Actual explicit planting choices and locations captured in s2
Verified site map from s1
outputs: Draft actual planting map and project entries with exact selected fields

steps.what: Write the actual project explanation and check the complete planting plan against site conditions, species choices, quantities, placement and resources
inputs: Actual draft project map and entries from s3
Original site evidence and human design
outputs: Complete actual planting plan with ordinary technical and completeness checks

steps.what: Save the actual completed project plan in the same system
inputs: Actual completed plan from s4
outputs: Saved actual planting project plan

steps.what: Brief the actual crew on the planting plan on site and answer questions about real placement and conditions
inputs: Actual completed plan and current field conditions
Actual planting crew
outputs: Human field briefing, clarified requirements and unresolved issues

steps.what: Supervise the actual planting and seedling growth observations and assess departures from the project requirements
inputs: Actual fieldwork and seedlings
Actual plan and current site evidence
outputs: Actual supervision and human assessment of establishment and growth concerns

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} planting map and project fields from actual species, quantity and placement choices made by the forester. Keep field planning, actual project writing, ordinary plan checks, crew briefing and direct supervision human; same-system save is ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual planting project can repeat already selected quantities and locations in its map and project record.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forestry project and map fields can reproduce exact human-selected planting choices.
tasks.still_hard: Site conditions and seedling outcomes require actual field judgement and crew support.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a feasible planting design and respond to actual establishment problems.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 including employee consultation if crew work records change

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native forestry maps and project records can reuse exact selected planting fields while site decisions, crew briefing and supervision remain human.

assumptions: This representative project establishes trees and monitors seedlings; nursery and thinning duties have different actual work and cannot inherit these shares. Shares are unmeasured and independent of the supplied prior.

The forester verifies actual site and resource evidence in s1 and chooses and captures all planting decisions in s2. No free measured site, approved species list or structured planting design is assumed.
Use native fields first. Existing map and project automation and runtime are baseline. All actual explanation and ordinary complete-plan checking remain in s4; no new self-approval is added.

Ordinary existing project authority and any genuine land-manager approval remain required. No new approval ceremony is assumed, and any actual additional final-plan review must have its real labour counted. Saving does not authorise a new physical operation.

The same-system save is ungated, negligible and earns no saving, with 1 the schema minimum. Field briefing is actual live conversation, not a hidden machine notice or work-order send. Crew planting labour remains unchanged and is not counted as focal saving.

No automatic planting, seed purchase, thinning, new crew assignment or changed plan commit is performed. Actual additional records or changes found during supervision must have their real writing and actions counted rather than being hidden in s7.
unknowns: Actual project duty mix, map duplication and existing project authority
research_questions: Which exact planting fields are manually repeated in an observed project, separately from real field supervision?

already_counted.description: Actual site consultation, planting design, substantive plan work, crew briefing and field supervision remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain exact planting field mappings and test field-boundary and project-version exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving=20 from actual repeated planting map and project fields. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 17. Physical planting, field judgement, briefing and ungated save earn no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and direct actual forest surveys and prepare reports and recommendations

steps.what: Plan the actual forest survey question, sampling, field measurements, study method and explicit analysis rules
inputs: Actual forest survey purpose and available site evidence
Existing forestry survey and analysis system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Human-designed actual survey method and captured explicit analysis requirements

steps.what: Direct the actual survey team through field briefing, practical method explanation and resolution of survey questions
inputs: Actual survey team, site and plan from s1
outputs: Actual field direction and clarified survey requirements

steps.what: Collect and verify actual field survey returns and capture selected records, plot associations, units and source exceptions
inputs: Actual field-team observations produced under the survey plan
outputs: Actual verified selected survey records and explicit mappings with unresolved observations exposed

steps.what: Import exact selected survey records and calculate the explicit native descriptive study tables
inputs: Actual selected records and mappings from s3
Explicit calculations selected and captured in s1
outputs: Draft source-linked survey tables with missing values and discrepancies visible

steps.what: Interpret the actual survey findings and determine supported forestry recommendations and limits
inputs: Actual original survey evidence and tables from s3-s4
outputs: Human survey conclusions, recommendations and uncertainties

steps.what: Write the actual survey report and recommendations and check the entire completed document against field sources, methods, tables and uncertainty
inputs: Actual findings and recommendations from s5 and all original survey evidence
outputs: Complete actual human-authored survey report and recommendations with ordinary source checks

steps.what: Save the actual completed survey report and recommendations in the same system
inputs: Actual complete report from s6
outputs: Saved actual report and recommendations

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} survey imports and exact descriptive tables from actual field returns verified by the forester. Retain survey design, field direction, interpretation and actual {DOCS} report and recommendation writing and checking, with no self-gate on the ordinary save.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual survey report can require repeated field-return transfer and descriptive table construction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native survey imports and explicit calculation rules can reproduce selected study tables.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling and field inconsistencies determine what the actual survey can establish.
tasks.human_edge: Direct a valid survey and turn its real evidence into justified recommendations.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native survey imports and descriptive calculations can support reports without replacing field survey design, direction or forestry interpretation.

assumptions: This conditional survey has actual manual field-return transfer and tables. Shares are illustrative and independent of the supplied prior, not measured staffing or survey time.

The forester produces and captures actual survey and calculation choices in s1, directs actual work in s2 and verifies and captures selected returns and mappings in s3. Field-team original observations remain existing baseline work and are not transferred free new labour.

Use native survey tools first. Existing imports, tables and unattended runtime are baseline. Missing or contradictory observations remain visible and require retained human resolution; no model creates field values.
All actual interpretation, report wording, recommendations and ordinary complete-source checking remain in s5-s6. No new self-approval is introduced.

Same-system save is ungated, negligible and earns no saving, with 1 the schema minimum. No report send, enacted recommendation or field-control action occurs silently; actual issue needs its own genuine authority and separate action.
Deduplicate actual shared survey capture, maps and tables against 208 or 199 where they are the same work.
unknowns: Actual survey-system import coverage and source exception workload
research_questions: Can an actual report's tables be reproduced exactly from the real field returns and selected analysis definitions?

already_counted.description: Actual survey design, field direction, source verification, interpretation and full report writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain verified survey mappings and analysis rules and review source-version exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving=20 from actual repeated survey transfer and tables. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 17. Source production, interpretation, actual report writing and ungated save remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
